terminology.standard: No formal industry standard or certification is claimed. Jepsen is a testing practice/tool; linearizability and serializability are mathematical correctness conditions; vendor contracts are product-specific.

records.established: Stable logical identity, a retained completion/effect record and logged nondeterministic decisions are established recovery mechanisms.
records.residual_or_caveat: An implementation comparison may expose violated preconditions; combining these mechanisms is not a new algorithm.

records.established: Regenerating or compacting a plan while retaining positional identities can bind a different operation to an old identity. Replay keys and retained decisions directly precede this question.
records.residual_or_caveat: A fresh-model witness can illustrate the known order/identity hazard, not establish its first discovery.

antecedents: Revocation Is Not Complete at Receipt (2610.15991)
records.established: Revocation or cancellation must reach protected-effect admission; an old worker or completed transport acknowledgement is insufficient.
records.residual_or_caveat: A memory API with no promised quiescence has a feature boundary, not automatically a contract defect.

records.established: Immutable accepted-operation binding and monotone current authority answer different questions; epochs, exact rebind and historical obligations already make this distinction.
records.residual_or_caveat: Dedup-before-fence can return historical success without new mutation; fence-before-dedup can deny. Typed status contracts are required before declaring either incorrect.

records.established: Lifecycle changes, stale writes, dependency repair, memory exposure and trajectory correctness already extend evaluation beyond recall.
records.residual_or_caveat: No first beyond-recall memory benchmark claim is supportable from this audit.

records.established: Independently valid conditional writes can jointly violate a predicate; per-key linearizability and snapshot isolation do not supply arbitrary multi-record serializability.
records.residual_or_caveat: Write skew is classical. A MemTX partial-commit path should not be scored against an unclaimed whole-plan invariant.

records.established: Dedup state has an explicit validity/reclamation scope. Legitimate later occurrences and stale earlier retries must be distinguished.
records.residual_or_caveat: Reexecution after an advertised retention window is not a violation. Permanent content-hash suppression is not equivalent to operation identity.

records.established: Independent histories and effect/cardinality oracles can test whether a pinned implementation realizes a narrowly stated contract.
records.residual_or_caveat: A bounded discrepancy is useful evidence but does not by itself establish a new protocol, general prevalence or journal readiness.

records.established: Write-time semantic duplicate recognition is publicly described as candidate bounded; concurrency and expiration separately affect exact-hash handling.
records.residual_or_caveat: A conditional sequential literal N−k capacity witness is narrower than these reports, but broad retrieval-to-write dependence is already described.
